# `field`

Helper: `field(label, o)` and `input select date time month number textarea check radio search file range`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Field` (`field.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaTextField` (core:ui), `PemaDropdownField` (name only (not in core:ui yet)), `PemaSearchField` (core:ui), `PemaCheckRow` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Label (label 12/600, ink-soft, optional red asterisk), control, hint, error line. Controls: input, select, date, time, month, number, textarea, check, radio, search, file, range.

## Variants

- Text-like (input, number, date, time, month, search)
- select (with open option list)
- textarea (`lines`)
- check, radio
- range, file

## States

- Default: line-strong border, field fill
- Focus: brand-500 border and ring (kit)
- Error: danger border and message
- Disabled: 60% opacity
- Checked: brand-500 fill

## Tokens

field, line-strong, ink, ink-soft, danger, brand-500, radius-field, text-body-lg (value), text-label (label)

## Do

- Label verbatim from the old screen
- Show the hint under the control and the error replacing nothing (both can show)

## Don't

- Do not use a placeholder as the label
- Do not hide the label on a phone

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Control min-height 40; `w` sets a width in a row.

## Mobile (390)

Controls take the full row width.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

One field per old field, label verbatim. `o`: `req hint err ph lines opts open dis w`. `select(..., { open: true, opts })` shows the option list
